definitions.explanation: The highest form of happiness or joy. A state of complete, perfect satisfaction.

examples.japanese: {至福|しふく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ひととき→ひととき：10494_hitotoki⟧だ。
⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|つ}かって→浸かる：13290_tsukaru⟧{至福|しふく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I spent a blissful time soaking in a hot spring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{焼|や}きたて→焼きたて：16735_yakitate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頬張|ほおば}る→頬張る：14618_hoobaru⟧⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧{至福|しふく}だ。
examples.english: The moment you bite into freshly baked bread is pure bliss.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {至|し} (utmost, supreme) and {福|ふく} (happiness, good fortune). Often used in the set phrase {至福|しふく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ひととき→ひととき：10494_hitotoki⟧ (a blissful moment) or {至福|しふく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (blissful time). Common in writing about food, relaxation, and luxury experiences.

NOTE: Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{私服|しふく}→私服：11177_shifuku⟧ (plain clothes, casual wear).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {至福|しふく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ひととき→ひととき：10494_hitotoki⟧ (a blissful moment)
- {至福|しふく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (blissful time)
- {至福|しふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{味|あじ}わう→味わう：04405_ajiwau⟧ (to savor bliss)
- {至福|しふく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちた→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧ (filled with bliss)
